Live evidence 2026-11-11 PST (session 3d705fec). Production bridge = .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml on main; every run below has a head SHA descending from b878c4be768 (checked with git merge-base --is-ancestor). Each run was dispatched (gh workflow run) after the triggering write reached origin/tickets. REB versions re-checked at 16:16 PST: [] (read-only GET /rest/api/3/project/REB/versions).

Probe: centauric-bony-impala (cf6d-5d0a-dfb4-4b8b), created via MCP create_ticket with bridge_project=REB, tagged probe, parent this ticket. Pushed to tickets 16:17:27 PST.

1. Binding — run 43126417285 (head c80576dfdb3, 16:19:16-16:26:26 PST, success). .bridge_state/bindings.json on origin/tickets: bindings[cf6d-5d0a-dfb4-4b8b].jira_key = REB-7117. GET /rest/api/3/issue/REB-7117: summary "[probe] fix-version sync check (plucky-jetblack-parrot) - safe to close", fixVersions [], status To Do. Log: "RECON: outbound_differ total=18 create=1".
2. Withhold — `rebar edit centauric-bony-impala --add-release rebar-fixver-probe` (worktree CLI; the production MCP edit_ticket does not yet expose add_releases, see reddish-drinkable-canvasback), pushed 16:28:07 PST. Run 43127503834 (head c80576dfdb3, 16:28:14-16:36:41 PST, success). rebar show: releases ['rebar-fixver-probe']; bridge_alerts [release-version-missing:rebar-fixver-probe, resolved False, uuid c00be723-e97c-4670-846e-d3e6606bf3a1]. GET REB-7117 fixVersions: []. Log: "RECON: outbound_update key=REB-7117 changed=[] comments=1 labels=0 links=0 releases=0" (no fixVersions write; no "fix version add failed" line; no release_alerts version-read warning).
3. Steady state / retry — run 43128646371 (head c80576dfdb3, 16:37:34-16:45:10 PST, success). Probe events on origin/tickets before 3, after 3 (CREATE, RELEASE_DELTA, BRIDGE_ALERT). Alert still unresolved; GET fixVersions []. Log: "outbound_update key=REB-7117 ... releases=0"; no version-read warning, so availability was known and the withholding re-ran.
4. Resolution — `rebar edit centauric-bony-impala --remove-release rebar-fixver-probe`, pushed 16:46:09 PST. Run 43129719419 (head fdf0a94aba8, 16:46:16-17:03:35 PST, success). rebar show: releases []; alert release-version-missing:rebar-fixver-probe resolved True (new BRIDGE_ALERT event 767a643e). GET REB-7117 fixVersions [].
5. Follow-up for the version-dependent checks (Jira->rebar, a release written to Jira, ADR 0124 screen question): cognitive-sooty-angelfish, parent the epic, linked discovered_from this ticket.
Note: the production MCP server's edit_ticket lacks add_releases/remove_releases because its code workspace lags main (reddish-drinkable-canvasback).
